notes.title: 📍 Leaf Blower Co. Demo Major Update - Based on Your Feedback
notes.notes:
🌱 Hey there! Your feedback has helped us make Leaf Blower Co. even better! 


As you might have seen in our previous post, we are heading to Cologne for Gamescom 2025. The event runs from 20 to 24 August and if you are also attending, you can come meet us in person.

We will be at The Indie Arena Booth where you can try out Forklift games, chat with the team, pick up exclusive giveaways and snap some fun photos with us. We will be there in full leaf blowing spirit and would love to meet you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/701ae711b27646b73e20922e022403b2540b43ab.png"]

But there is more. Steam is already featuring all Gamescom participants today and to celebrate we have updated the Leaf Blower Co. Demo. This update is based directly on your feedback and we are incredibly grateful for all the suggestions, bug reports and ideas you have shared. They have helped us make the game even better for everyone. Thank you!



And as special treat, we've even switched out one of the Freeplay levels - jump into the calming zen of the new Japanese Courtyard location now!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/Leaf_Blower_Co_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
🆕 New Content and Features
New job selection board: all jobs are now represented as postcards on a map, including bonus jobs

Mushrooms added (similar to weeds) to burn on ground and trees

New level unlocked after first area cleared (not seen before in the demo)

New "No Zones Mode" Prototype available in HUB — play without zones

Bonus Work now has random weather and time

Air now blows along the ground instead of just at leaves which are pointed at directly

New butterflies added to the Mayor’s house

Clean wipes happen in each zone for every 25% of total leaves collected in that zone

🎮 Gameplay Changes

XP now earned twice as fast

Leaves are randomly dispersed on each level every time you play

Crows are random across all levels they’re in

Weeds are random across all levels they’re in

Leaves will not get kicked forward in first person mode but will in 3rd person mode

Tarp bag stacking improved

Bins now have a cluster mode that counts leaves blown into them continuously until 3 seconds have elapsed without any getting blown in, then displays and awards points

Bins count down the number of leaves remaining

Ground Circle on for Shredder, off for Leafblower (default setting)

🎨 Visuals and UI

New animations and floor wipes for cleared areas (every 25% cleared) with on-screen indication

UI updates to show progression

Ground circle indicator off by default, can be enabled in Settings → General

FOV now available as an option in Settings

The TAB key now toggles the HUD on and off

Cursor reverted to standard cursor to avoid input lag issue on menus

Emissive leaves always off even at night

🔊 Audio

Lots of sounds removed for a more zen experience

🏠 World Interactions

Shower can now be turned off in Mayor's house

💡 Quality of Life

Update to pop-up tips

Random jobs no longer set in pitch dark (can still be called from freeplay)

🐞 Bug Fixes

Snow no longer collects on pipes so numbers can always be seen clearly regardless of weather

Coconuts no longer play audio for too long when under water

Boxes in suburb fixed so they no longer disappear

POV bug fixed

Weeds and crow counts fixed so they match the objectives

Mushroom counts fixed on the side underneath the level indicator

Bug with "mushroom taken care of" text on the UI causing the level radial wheel to be the wrong size is now fixed



— The Leaf Blower Team



JOIN OUR DISCORD

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
Minor Update: Freeplay Hint, Furniture Fix, and More



You’ll now get a reminder about Freeplay mode when using the PC on Day 2, so it's easier to notice when it's available

Fixed a bug where furniture could behave oddly after being "fixed", it's now much more stable

Added a helpful hint in Freeplay mode about turning on your headlamp at night

Thanks again for all your bug reports and feedback. Keep them coming 💚
